name: hrih-skills
description: Agent Skills by Hatim Rih: design from real references, copy that reads like a person wrote it, and code review that people and agents learn from.

plugins.name: design-inspiration
plugins.description: Researches current design galleries (land-book, supahero, pricingpages, reallygoodemails, deck.gallery and more) before designing websites, emails, decks, social posts or ads, then builds from the best references.

plugins.name: copywriter
plugins.description: Writes and rewrites website, email, ad, social and UX copy from facts and customer language, then edits it against an evidence-based catalog of AI-writing tells. Humanizes AI drafts, matches a voice from a sample or link, and never invents stats or testimonials.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Code review for teams where agents write most of the code: route changes by risk, review against the spec and the evidence, and turn reviews into teaching. All three share a REVIEW-LESSONS.md memory that people teach and agents read.
